notes.title: We changed the whole game ! Update #2
notes.content:
It's been a while since I came with an update, but that's not because I haven't been working on the game. It's because this is quite a big update. Which you can play right now, if you try out the demo.

The reason why this is a bigger update is because the game before was quite bare bones, it featured one level and two guns. I wanted to expand the game and figure out the gameplay loop. My initial idea was to create 3 different levels and then maybe a boos in the end, however I'm a big fan of procedural generation so why not have endless levels and then a leaderboard? That's why I implemented, that and more is descripted in this video devlog:

[previewyoutube=fCff0DYWYbE;full][/previewyoutube]

I also did a intro to the game, which is described in this devlog:

[previewyoutube=qQK9a3fGHww;full][/previewyoutube]

Needless to say a lot of stuff happened, I hope you will try it out and spill some blood. Let me know what you think.

/Dennis

notes.title: Wondering how pigs came to be? #devlog 1
notes.content:
[h1]How it all started:[/h1]
[b]I run a YouTube channel[/b] ːsteamboredː I thought it could be fun to create an game, but with the perspective of having no skills. So that's what I did. 40-something hours late I had something that looked like a game. You can see the whole process in this video:

[previewyoutube=mVSOWJ2lhOY;full][/previewyoutube]

You can compare this to an prototype, it was really helpful for me to start this way. I do have a good grasp on 3D graphics in my humble opinion ːsteamhappyː After I had created the fun little experiment I decided why not make it into a super cool real game. So that's what I'm trying to do now. Let's hope I don't fail.

[img]https://c.tenor.com/CPKCfcHUL3EAAAAM/fingers-crossed-jenny-hagel.gif[/img]

[h1]So what's the game gonna be?[/h1]
Well I wanna go crazy, not full crazy, because you never go full crazy. BUT I do wanna mash a ton of ideas into this game, and then try to stich it up to something releasable. At it's core it's just an top downer shooter with roguelike elements, but I wanna add aspects that makes it fun to die. Kinda like a perk or a buff when you die. I'm not sure if they will be permanent. This also brings me to the story.

[h1]What story?[/h1]
Well ehh... At some point I will add a story. The ambition is to have a lot of different small stories in the game, meaning that when you die, you won't actually experience the ending of that story, because next time you retry it's a totally new story. How sick would that be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42293772/b787f5a80f672d17e4386df7018562433ca1d4a9.png[/img]

[h1]What about gameplay?[/h1]
Oh I forgot to mention you can play the demo right now. Give it a go, I will be updating it along the way. How the gameplay turns out in the end? Hell I dunno. Let the chips fall where they may. What I do know is that I don't wanna spend 5 years on a game again. So don't expect the next No man's sky. This experience is gonna be short and sweet, and worth the price of something that's free or maybe a few bucks.

[img]https://c.tenor.com/vpva0KfiifsAAAAC/rich-money.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for another devlog, and don't be shy, get involved, let me know what you hate and love... and also what you think about the game.

Much Love ːsteamthumbsupː,
/Dennis
